messages.Automatically Added Holiday: Automatically read from an approved holiday.
messages.No Working Days: There are no working days in this month.
messages.Download Not Ready: Exports become available after every employee has a working schedule and completes all elapsed working days, unless incomplete exports are enabled by an administrator.
messages.Overview Page Guide: Select a month to review employee completion, missing attendance, schedule coverage, and the daily register.
messages.Register Ready Detail: All required information is complete. The XLSX and PDF registers are ready to download.
messages.Incomplete Export Detail: The register is incomplete, but XLSX and PDF downloads are allowed by the administration setting.
messages.Register Blocked Detail: The XLSX and PDF registers are not ready yet.
messages.Readiness No Data: There are no completed attendance entries for this month.
messages.Readiness Month Locked: The selected month is read-only for employees.
messages.Locked Month Reminder: Reminders cannot be sent because employees can no longer edit this month.
messages.Daily Matrix Guide: Each row is a working day and each column is an employee. Missing entries are highlighted.
messages.Confirm Reminders: Send an in-app notification to every employee with missing entries?
messages.Reminder Failed: The reminders could not be sent.
messages.Download Failed: The attendance file could not be generated.
messages.Invalid Schedule: Enter a valid start and end time. The end time must be after the start time.
messages.Schedule Saved: The employee's default working schedule was saved.
messages.Schedule Save Failed: The working schedule could not be saved.
messages.Schedule Load Failed: Employee schedules could not be loaded.
messages.Settings Page Guide: Configure attendance rules, initialize the visible archive, and set each employee's working schedule.
messages.Attendance Configuration Help: These settings control which months employees may edit and when incomplete registers can be exported.
messages.Schedule Editor Guide: Choose the normal start and end time for each employee. Times are saved independently for each row.
messages.Editable Previous Months Help: The number of previous calendar months in which employees may still change their attendance.
messages.Allow Incomplete Exports Help: Allow the register to be downloaded even when attendance entries or schedules are missing.
messages.Settings Load Failed: Attendance settings could not be loaded.
messages.Invalid Settings: The number of editable months must be between 0 and 120.
messages.Settings Save Failed: Attendance settings could not be saved.
messages.Initialize Attendance Help: Start the visible attendance archive from the current month. Older database records are preserved.
messages.Archive Automatic Detection: The archive start is currently detected automatically.
messages.Confirm Initialize Attendance: Initialize the attendance register from the current month? Older records will not be deleted, but earlier months will no longer appear in the attendance archive.
messages.Attendance Initialized: The attendance register was initialized from the current month.
messages.Attendance Initialize Failed: The attendance register could not be initialized.
messages.Attendance Page Guide: Mark where you are working today, or review and complete an earlier working day.
messages.Business Trip Help: Working away on a business trip
messages.Today Marking Guide: Choose one option. You can change it later if you selected the wrong one.
messages.Holiday Locked Guide: Approved leave is added automatically and cannot be changed here.
messages.Today Unavailable Guide: Today is not an available working day, so no action is required.
messages.Monthly Register Guide: Review your working days and complete any day marked as not completed.
messages.Month Locked Guide: This month is read-only. Attendance can only be changed in the current and permitted previous months.
